items.summary: Disposition: blocked for searchwoot.com bounded public beta, full launch, public data display, alerts expansion, affiliate use, or advertising use; counsel_required for upstream rights, public display, alerts, trademark/image/price claims, affiliate/advertising use, and jurisdiction-specific privacy treatment. Recommendation: keep searchwoot.com private, keep permission outreach unsent, and do not approve a go-live gate. Evidence: Woot documentation confirms API access mechanics but not redistribution rights; current public terms restrict commercial/public use, listings, prices, derivatives, and data mining. Technical compliance is only a baseline: 35 pass, 18 fail, 6 unknown. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, owner, privacy, consent, vendor, and incident gates remain incomplete. Ordinary reversible growth is conditional when it preserves existing consent, disclosures, provenance, claims, platform-policy, and data boundaries; incomplete telemetry alone is not a blocker. This is risk triage, not legal advice or certification.

Launch-readiness remains active: 0 of 4 tasks closed and 4 remain open. No task can close because current evidence does not establish source rights, field-level permissions, retention/deletion/correction/access workflows, notification consent, GA4 settings, vendor coverage, incident procedures, accuracy/freshness controls, or rollback evidence. Next evidence action: attach and review one consolidated read-only bundle covering the field-level rights matrix, deployed data-flow and retention table, log/vendor/incident inventory, consent and GA4 configuration evidence, accuracy/freshness controls, and rollback evidence. Keep the private gate unchanged and outreach unsent.

No legal launch clearance is available. Preserve parked/private status and do not publish, deploy, alter DNS, configure analytics, monetize upstream data, expand alerts, or send outreach. Continue only the existing read-only readiness evidence work and attach the consolidated evidence bundle when complete.
